lines: Having entered the root from the kanda-region, cutting from non-differ
ence-discernment, by full-oblation use he should join in his own-desir
l4.sanskrit_cite: praviśya mūlaṃ kandādeśchindannaikyavibhāvanāt pūrṇāhutiprayogeṇa sveṣṭe dhāmni niyojayet
